messages.content: Add a title line first, then write the main content. Format the title line using this exact prefix: "title - ". Do not exceed 130 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Include all of these keywords or phrases at least once: ['member']. Finish with "The other breaks logic outright if you try to admit it." and don’t add anything after it.

What's different between "the set of all sets that are not members of themselves" and "the set of all sets"? Do not finish until all required keywords/phrases are included: ['member']. End your response with this exact line: "The other breaks logic outright if you try to admit it.". Keep it to 130 words or fewer. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.) Start with a title line before the body text. Use "title - " at the beginning of the title line.
